_comment: Achat in-app NON-CONSOMMABLE « Sans pub ». Prix de base en EUR (territoire FRA) : Apple dérive les autres pays. Le productId doit correspondre exactement à AdFreeManager.productID (tenGO/AdFreeManager.swift) et au fichier tenGO/tenGO.storekit.

products.reviewNote: Non-consumable. Permanently removes the banner ad and the full-screen interstitial ads. The OPTIONAL rewarded video (circular button on the main menu, grants +10 in-game coins) is intentionally kept available after purchase: it is a voluntary opt-in reward the user taps himself, not an intrusive ad. This is stated in the product description ("banner and full-screen ads"). The purchase is restorable from Settings > Restore purchases. No account or login required. To test: on the main menu, tap the mint circular button ("Sans pub", 3,99 EUR) located just below the golden rewarded-video button.
products._comment_desc: ASC limite la description à 55 caractères (et le nom à 30).
